quotes.text: Less lines of code than vanilla C while abusing query planning as a state machine is peak engineering malpractice. I love it.
quotes.author: soltanov
quotes.source: Hacker News — We ported the original Doom to SQL
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect reaction to cursed-but-impressive code: calls it malpractice while loving every second.

quotes.text: He returned to the master and said: "Master, you have the only uncorrupted copy!" But the master had already overwritten it with a copy of DOOM.
quotes.author: tovve
quotes.source: Hacker News — The Tao of Backup
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect comedic timing on a real engineering sin — DOOM overwriting the last good backup is universal dev humor.
